steps.code:
# Parse the old songs list into a set of (title, artists) tuples
import re
old_songs = set()
for line in file_data['content'].splitlines():
    line = line.strip()
    if not line or line.startswith('#'):
        continue
    # Format: "- Title by Artist1, Artist2"
    m = re.match(r'^- (.+) by (.+)$', line)
    if m:
        title = m.group(1).strip()
        artists = [a.strip() for a in m.group(2).split(',')]
        old_songs.add((title, tuple(artists)))
print(f"Parsed {len(old_songs)} old songs")
for t, a in sorted(old_songs):
    print(f"  {t} by {', '.join(a)}")

steps.code:
# Build old songs set with frozenset of artist names
old_songs_set = set()
for line in file_data['content'].splitlines():
    line = line.strip()
    if not line or line.startswith('#'):
        continue
    m = re.match(r'^- (.+) by (.+)$', line)
    if m:
        title = m.group(1).strip()
        artists = tuple(a.strip() for a in m.group(2).split(','))
        old_songs_set.add((title, frozenset(artists)))
print(f"Old songs set size: {len(old_songs_set)}")

# Now iterate through all playlists and find matching songs
matches = []  # list of (playlist_id, song_id)
unique_song_ids = set()
for playlist in all_playlists:
    pid = playlist['playlist_id']
    for sid in playlist['song_ids']:
        song = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
        song_title = song['title']
        song_artists = frozenset(a['name'] for a in song['artists'])
        if (song_title, song_artists) in old_songs_set:
            matches.append((pid, sid))
            unique_song_ids.add(sid)
            print(f"Match: '{song_title}' by {', '.join(sorted(song_artists))} in playlist {playlist['title']} (id={pid})")

print(f"\nTotal matches: {len(matches)}")
print(f"Unique song IDs: {len(unique_song_ids)}")
